answer: 在心理学（RPP，project=='rpp'）被成功复制（replicated==1）的研究中，复制研究最资深作者为初级教授（seniority.r ∈ {Assistant, Assistant Professor}，假设两者为同一职级的不同写法）的比例约为 46%（16/35 ≈ 45.7%）。敏感性口径：仅 Assistant Professor 为 28.6%（10/35）；计入副教授的宽口径为 65.7%（23/35）；剔除 drop==True 后为 51.6%（16/31）。该子集 replicated 与 seniority.r 均无缺失、每研究一行无需聚合；Psychology 对应 rpp 系基于数据文档 project 编码说明的推断，属假设。

payload.hypothesis: In replicated studies in Psychology (RPP, project=='rpp'), the proportion whose replication team's most senior author is a junior professor (seniority.r in {Assistant, Assistant Professor}) is approximately 46% (16/35 ≈ 45.7%). Sensitivity: Assistant Professor only 28.6% (10/35); broad (incl. Associate Professor) 65.7% (23/35); excluding drop==True rows 51.6% (16/31).
payload.workflow: Loaded the 927x57 meta-regression CSV; filtered project=='rpp' and replicated==1 (35 rows; no missing replicated or seniority.r in rpp; one row per study, no lab aggregation needed); main junior definition = {Assistant, Assistant Professor} (flagged assumption); computed main proportion plus three sensitivity analyses (narrow, broad incl. Associate, drop==True excluded).
